newsitem.title: GREECE: CITIBANK, ATHENS TO CUT INSTALLMENT LOAN RATES BY 100 BPS.
newsitem.headline: CITIBANK, ATHENS TO CUT INSTALLMENT LOAN RATES BY 100 BPS.

text.p: Citibank will cut its base lending
rate for personal installment loans with and without invoices by
100 basis points but leave all other base loan rates unchanged
Citibank, which reviews its rates weekly, offers the
** Base rate for working capital loans at 16.25 percent
** Business and professional base lending rate at 17.00 percent
** Base rate for freely investible funds at 16.50 percent
** Personal installment loans at 22 percent from 23 percent
** Personal installment loans with invoices at 20 percent from
** Auto loans through representative at 18.75 percent
Contribution under Law 128 is not included in the rates
